_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Aviation Resource Management System (ARMS) Additional Training Accomplishment Report
summary: The ARMS Additional Training Accomplishment Report documents contractor training completion status in the USAF Aviation Resource Management Database using AMC Form 1522 as the source document.
use_relationship:
The Aviation Resource Management System (ARMS) Additional Training Accomplishment Report documents the status of the contractor's effort towards achieving contract objectives. It identifies a method to track completion of training in the United States Air Force (USAF) Aviation Resource Management Database. The Air Mobility Command (AMC) Form 1522, ARMS Additional Training Accomplishment Report, serves as the source document for training completion documentation. (Copies of AMC Form 1522 are available online at: https://static.e-publishing.af.mil/production/1/af_a3/form/af1522/af1522.pdf.)

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The ARMS Additional Training Accomplishment Report shall be in accordance with AMC Form 1522 and shall be in Adobe Portable Document Format (PDF).

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The ARMS Additional Training Accomplishment Report shall comply with AMC Form 1522 and shall contain the following:

children.title: Social Security Number (SSN) shall be left blank.
Event Description, which shall be identified as "Initial," "Refresher," or "Flight Simulator Training," as applicable.
Event Identifier.
children.content: For Initial and Refresher training, indicate "G250." Otherwise, Event Identifier shall be left blank.

children.title: Instructor Certification indicating that the training was completed by the trainee.
